title: Process-Wide Connection Pool with Timeouts
instructions: In `spool.py`, implement `ConnectionPool` (blocking `acquire` with a timeout, `release` that rejects double release, a `connection()` context manager that always releases) and the process-wide accessor `get_pool(size=None)` that is lazy, thread-safe and rejects a conflicting size. `reset_pool()` clears the global for tests.

evidence.label: Ten simultaneous get_pool() calls create exactly one pool
Default size is 10 and reset_pool() allows a new pool
A conflicting explicit size raises ValueError
size < 1 raises ValueError and connections compare by identity
An exhausted pool raises PoolTimeout after the timeout
connection() releases even when the body raises
Releasing a connection twice raises ValueError
A blocked acquire wakes up after a release
